text:
Both `header.json` and the updated `units-005.json` have been handed in and accepted by `plan-lint --section`:

- **`U85` (`.changeset/require-react-18.md`, `phase: "docs"`)**: Covers the other 57 affected published packages (16 `major` packages at `>=1.0.0`, with `@backstage/test-utils` removed from frontmatter, and 41 `minor` packages at `<1.0.0`), describing only the React 18 (`^18.0.0`) peer dependency requirement in plain adopter-facing prose with no `@backstage/test-utils` migration text (`covers`: `["FR-9", "NFR-2", "NFR-3", "NFR-4", "NFR-6", "AC-8"]`).
- **`U86` (`.changeset/test-utils-remove-legacy-root.md`, `phase: "docs"`)**: Covers `@backstage/test-utils: major` only, describing both the removal of the `LegacyRootOption` type and `legacyRoot` option on `renderWithEffects` and `renderInTestApp` (with migration guidance to remove `legacyRoot` from render calls) and the React 18 (`^18.0.0`) peer dependency requirement (`covers`: `["FR-6", "FR-9", "NFR-2", "NFR-3", "NFR-4", "NFR-6", "AC-8"]`).
